prompt: A realistic 1920s photograph on grainy colour film: real people with real skin, pores and stubble. Sprayed over the photograph with aerosol paint: fluorescent pink and acid yellow overspray clouds, hard-edged stencilled halftone shapes and long paint drips running down through the scene, while every face stays real. Camera behind the counter of a shop full of loaves, looking out past a brass cash register. A heavy-set Black man in his fifties with a shaved head, a broken nose and a double chin, in a sweat-stained vest, flour on his forearms empties his whole pay envelope onto the counter to buy one small loaf; above him a blank chalkboard; the shopkeeper's hand reaching for the coins. Light: morning sun through the steamed window, the counter's brass shining. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
